acceptance_criteria.criterion: New env vars documented in .env.example with descriptions and defaults

summary: Documented STREAM_MAX_RETRIES and STREAM_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_S in orchestrator/.env.example with inline comments describing purpose, defaults, and the backoff formula.
Added both env vars to the Environment Variable Reference table in orchestrator/README.md with defaults, descriptions, and fallback behavior notes.
Added stage_retry to the Action Values table in orchestrator/docs/jsonl-log-schema.md with all emitted fields (stage, wp_id, attempt, max_attempts, error, delay_s, level).
Updated the stage ordering section in jsonl-log-schema.md to reflect the new stage_retry entries that can appear between stage_start and stage_complete.
Regenerated .context/ snapshot docs via ctx generate.

comments.note: orchestrator/docs/jsonl-log-schema.md: The code-review pipeline for WP-003 flagged a forward-looking concern that the Config.stream_retry_base_delay_s docstring references the backoff formula 'base * 2^attempt * jitter'. This formula is now confirmed as implemented in _accumulate_stream() (orchestrator/src/nodes/__init__.py line ~530). The docstring is accurate — no correction needed.
No documentation gaps found. The documentation-forward from WP-003 code review (docstring formula accuracy) was verified against the WP-004 implementation and found to be correct.
